# INDAGOR

> INDAGOR is a digital engineering studio: websites and web applications, AI assistants and business process automation, CRM and management analytics, digital ecosystems for commercial real estate. We work remotely, worldwide. Contact: Telegram direct messages — https://t.me/INDAGOR_CEO. Channel: https://t.me/indagor_digital.

This site is available for AI indexing and retrieval at https://indagor.online. Russian version: https://indagor.ru.

## Services

- [Digital products](https://indagor.online/#expertise): corporate websites, web applications, customer portals, internal platforms and integrations.
- [AI and automation](https://indagor.online/#expertise): intelligent assistants, bots, automation of requests, documents and repetitive operations.
- [CRM, analytics and operations](https://indagor.online/#expertise): request tracking, service integrations, management reporting, data visualisation.
- [Real estate digital ecosystems](https://indagor.online/#expertise): solutions for shopping and business centres — tenants, units, requests, services and operations.

## Product

- [Klondayk](https://indagor.online/klondayk/): dedicated product page — modules, principles, platform composition. Summary on the home page: https://indagor.online/#klondayk. A platform concept for managing digital services of commercial real estate — shopping and business centres, commercial spaces and their tenants. Architecture and module set adapt to each property. Built by INDAGOR.
